lines.t: (Verse 1)
Lost in the quiet of my broken soul,
I wandered through shadows, chasing control.
Empty promises burned and disappeared,
Till YahuShua whispered, “I am still here.”
(Pre-Chorus)
Your light cuts through the dark I knew,
Every fear fades when I see You.
(Chorus)
You’re my eternal glow —
Burning through every moment slow.
When the world turns cold, You shine below,
YahuShua, my eternal glow.
(Verse 2)
I’ve felt the fire and the cold rain fall,
I tried to stand but lost it all.
Then Your mercy found me in disguise,
Wrapped in warmth beneath Your skies.
(Pre-Chorus)
I see reflections of grace unfold,
Turning night into threads of gold.
(Chorus)
You’re my eternal glow —
Where my heart and heaven flow.
When I lose my way, You make it show,
YahuShua, my eternal glow.
(Bridge)
In the ruins, You build something new,
From ashes to colors, bright and true.
The light You give, no world can steal,
It’s more than feeling — it’s how I heal.
(Bridge 2 / Breakdown)
Your glow—it breathes inside my chest,
Every beat reminds me I’m blessed.
Past the stars, past time below,
You shine through all I’ll ever know.
(Final Chorus)
You’re my eternal glow —
Through every season, high or low.
YahuShua, when my spirit slows,
You awaken life where mercy flows.
(Outro)
Just like dawn across the years,
Your light dissolves the weight of fears.
I’ll keep walking where You show,
Forever Yours, my eternal glow.
